rationale: The evidence file log/tab_ipw_empl.scsv contains Table 5 panel B. In the d_t~eusch_pw ($1,000 import shock) row, the five share columns match the paper exactly: d_sh_em~_mfg = -0.596, d_sh_em~nmfg = -0.178, d_sh_unempl = 0.221, d_sh_nilf = 0.553, d_sh_ssadi~s = 0.076 (columns 6-10). The standard errors in parentheses also match exactly: (0.099), (0.137), (0.058), (0.150), (0.028). All ten cells are within 0% relative error of the paper values. Internal consistency also holds: the mfg + non-mfg sum (-0.596 + -0.178 = -0.774) equals the ~-0.77 pp emp/pop reduction, with ~1/4 (0.221) accruing to unemployment and ~3/4 (0.553) to nonparticipation, as described in the claim.
